Hi all,

  please review these widening issues during coarsening in card set card accounting.

The issue is that some intermediate `uint` result that intentionally can wrap to -1 are added to `size_t` ones. C++ widening rules make 2^32 out of that -1, which is then added to the size_t

This is purely an accounting issue that can negatively impact predictions.

Testing: gha

Thanks,
  Thomas
